lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: وَبَسَرَ is in the derivative form: بَسَرَ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ب/س/ر   b–s–r unripe green date; to do something prematurely; to scowl, to frown, to be gloomy.

Of this root, 2 forms occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
بَسَرَ basara and بَاسِرَةٌ bāsiratun.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
بَسَرَ basara u [v. intrans./trans.] to scowl, to look sour

(74:22) ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ then he frowned and looked sour.

entries.label: بَاسِرَةٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
بَاسِرَةٌ bāsiratun [act. part. fem.] scowling, frowning, despondent, sour

(75:24) وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ بَاسِرَةٌ and some faces on that day will look sour.
